export { DaprModule } from './dapr.module';
export { DaprClientProvider } from './dapr-client.provider';

name: '$(Date:yyyyMMdd)$(Rev:.r)'

# Use the Azure DevOps pipeline templates
resources:
  repositories:
    - repository: 'pipelines'
      type: 'git'
      name: 'Azure/template-pipelines'

trigger:
  batch: true
  branches:
    include:
      - develop
      - master
      - main

jobs:
  - template: jobs/sonar-process.yml@pipelines
    parameters:
      agent_pool: ubuntu-2204-vmss-mesx
      prepare_scanner_mode: CLI
      prepare_sonarExclusions: $(Build.SourcesDirectory)/node_modules/**
      prepare_sonarAdditionalProperties: |
        sonar.sources=$(Build.SourcesDirectory)/src
        sonar.test.inclusions=**/*.spec.ts
        sonar.tests=$(Build.SourcesDirectory)/src
        sonar.typescript.tsconfigPath=$(Build.SourcesDirectory)/tsconfig.lint.json

      step_postPrepare:
        - template: steps/angular-lint-and-test.yaml@pipelines
          parameters:
            nodejs_version: 20.x
            run_unit_tests: false

        - template: steps/sonarqube-reports.yml@pipelines
          parameters:
            reports:
              - name: sonar.junit.reportPaths
                path: $(Build.SourcesDirectory)/coverage/junit-tests.xml
              - name: sonar.eslint.reportPaths
                path: $(Build.SourcesDirectory)/report.json
              - name: sonar.testExecutionReportPaths
                path: $(Build.SourcesDirectory)/coverage/sonar-tests.xml
              - name: sonar.flex.cobertura.reportPaths
                path: $(Build.SourcesDirectory)/coverage/cobertura-coverage.xml
              - name: sonar.javascript.lcov.reportPaths
                path: $(Build.SourcesDirectory)/coverage/lcov.info
              - name: sonar.css.stylelint.reportPaths
                path: $(Build.SourcesDirectory)/stylelint.json

# base stage
FROM acrprdccr001.azurecr.io/library/node:lts-alpine AS base

WORKDIR /app

ENV NODE_ENV=production
ENV NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS="/etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt"

COPY --from=acrprdfaurecia001.azurecr.io/cloud/azure/ca-certificates:latest \
  /ca-certificates.crt \
  /etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt

EXPOSE 3000

# build stage
FROM acrprdccr001.azurecr.io/library/node:lts AS build

ENV NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS="/etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt"

COPY --from=acrprdfaurecia001.azurecr.io/cloud/azure/ca-certificates:latest \
  /ca-certificates.crt \
  /etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt

WORKDIR /app

COPY . .

RUN --mount=type=secret,id=npmrc,target=/root/.npmrc \
    npm ci \
    && npm run build

# runtime stage
FROM base AS runtime

COPY --from=build /app/dist dist/

# src is included in the runtime stage to enable running mv update script
COPY --from=build /app/src src/

COPY package.json package-lock.json .npmrc tsconfig.json ./

RUN --mount=type=secret,id=npmrc,target=/root/.npmrc \
    npm install --omit=dev

USER node

CMD ["npm", "run", "start:prod"]
# Picking Materialized View Processor

trigger: none

pool:
  name: ubuntu-2204-vmss-mesx

variables:
  jobName: 'cosmos-migration' 
  SOURCE_COSMOS_DB_ENDPOINT: $(SOURCE_COSMOS_DB_ENDPOINT)
  TARGET_COSMOS_DB_ENDPOINT: $(TARGET_COSMOS_DB_ENDPOINT)
  COSMOS_DB_CONTAINER: $(COSMOS_DB_CONTAINER)

parameters:
- name: azureSubscription
  displayName: Target Environment Subscription
  default: 'spn-dev-inf-mes'
  values:
  - 'spn-dev-inf-mes'
  - 'spn-ppr-inf-mes'
  - 'spn-pro-inf-mes'

steps:
- task: AzureCLI@2
  displayName: Configure az cli error output
  inputs:
    azureSubscription: ${{ parameters.azureSubscription }}
    scriptType: bash
    scriptLocation: inlineScript
    inlineScript: |
      az config set core.only_show_errors=yes
    failOnStandardError: false

- task: AzureCLI@2
  displayName: "Check if Cosmos migration job exists"
  inputs:
    azureSubscription: $(azureServiceConnection)
    scriptType: pscore
    scriptLocation: inlineScript
    inlineScript: |
      $jobName = "cosmos-migration"
      $rg = "rg-gptmpxn01-dev-eun-mes-01"

      $exists = az containerapp job show --name $jobName --resource-group $rg --only-show-errors 2>$null
      if (-not $exists) {
        Write-Host "Job $jobName does not exist. Creating it..."
        az containerapp job create `
          --name $jobName `
          --resource-group $rg `
          --environment <your-container-app-env-name> `
          --image <your-image> `
          --replica-timeout 1800 `
          --trigger-type Manual `
          --cpu 0.5 --memory 1.0Gi
      } else {
        Write-Host "Job $jobName already exists."
      }

- task: NodeTool@0
  inputs:
    versionSpec: '22'
  displayName: 'Install Node.js'

- script: |
    npm ci
    npm run cosmos-migrator
  displayName: 'Run Cosmos DB Migration Script'
  env:
    SOURCE_COSMOS_DB_ENDPOINT: $(SOURCE_COSMOS_DB_ENDPOINT)
    TARGET_COSMOS_DB_ENDPOINT: $(TARGET_COSMOS_DB_ENDPOINT)
    COSMOS_DB_CONTAINER: $(COSMOS_DB_CONTAINER)

resources:
  repositories:
  - repository: mesx-ops-pipelines
    type: git
    name: MES_X.0/mesx-ops-pipelines

trigger:
  tags:
    include:
    - '*'
  branches:
    include:
    - main
    - ci/*
  paths:
    exclude:
    - README.md

variables:
  isMain: $[eq(variables['Build.SourceBranch'], 'refs/heads/main')]
  caAppName: picking-mp

stages:
- stage: Build
  jobs:
  - template: test/jobs/jobs-node-static-tests.yml@mesx-ops-pipelines
    parameters:
      folder: $(System.DefaultWorkingDirectory)
      auditLevel: 'critical'


  - template: test/jobs/jobs-node-dynamic-tests.yml@mesx-ops-pipelines
    parameters:
      folder: $(System.DefaultWorkingDirectory)

  - template: build/jobs/jobs-docker-build.yml@mesx-ops-pipelines
    parameters:
      folder: $(System.DefaultWorkingDirectory)
      repository: mesx/picking-mv-processor

- stage: Dev
  condition: and(succeeded(), eq(variables.isMain, true))
  jobs:
  - template: deploy/jobs/jobs-container-apps-deploy.yml@mesx-ops-pipelines
    parameters:
      azureSubscription: spn-dev-inf-mes
      pipelineDeploymentEnvironment: app_cloud_dev_mes
      containerAppName: ca-gptmpxn01-eun-dev-$(caAppName)
      containerAppResourceGroupName: rg-gptmpxn01-dev-eun-mes-01
